name: ILI Group (Intelligent Land Investments Group plc)
ownership_summary: Hamilton-based clean energy and infrastructure development company; promoter of The Stoics three-site data centre programme (Cato, Rufus, Aurelius). Historically a developer that takes projects through consent rather than an operator. Registered office 33 Bothwell Road, Hamilton ML3 0AS — the applicant contact address on PAN 25/00989/PAN.

name: ILI Aurelius Limited
ownership_summary: Private limited company incorporated 9 October 2024, registered at ILI Group's office (33 Bothwell Road, Hamilton ML3 0AS); SIC 41201 construction of commercial buildings. Named as the party giving the statutory public-exhibition notice for the North Lanrigg site; the applicant name on the PAN itself is not visible via the PlanIt mirror.
notes: PSC/officer detail not captured. Greig Templeton (Planning Manager, gt@ili-energy.com) was the consultation contact; Simon Munro was the named PAN contact at the Hamilton address.

name: Action to Protect Rural Scotland (APRS)
notes: National charity running a Scotland-wide data centres campaign; tracks the Aurelius proposal ('ILI Aurelius, Newhouse') and, with the Woodhall Faskine and Palacecraig Conservation Group, has called for a combined assessment of all data centre developments around the North Lanarkshire AI Growth Zone.
